Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Suresh - 36 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Anjali - 31 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Anita - 64 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Sonali - 32 years, friend
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Suresh stands on the road. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "Suresh, what's the plan today?"

[Suresh starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Suresh (excited): "I'm ready!"

[Suresh is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Suresh (gently): "Yes, of course."

[Suresh steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Suresh: "That's great!"

[Suresh's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Suresh: "This is amazing!"

[Suresh's car crashes into a pole.]

Suresh: "That's easy."

[Suresh loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Anjali: "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Suresh stands by the road. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "Suresh, look over here."

[Suresh rides his motorbike to the market.]

Suresh: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Suresh starts his scooter and rides off.]

Anita: "Really?"

[Suresh drives the car to the office.]

Suresh: "Oh wow!"

[Suresh gets out of the car.]

Suresh: "That was such a fun day!"
